query: How much does the Sahyog Vridh Pension Top-up add to the old-age pension each month?
gold_answer: Rs 500 per month, for BPL pensioners aged 60 or above.

query: When must the life certificate be submitted to keep the Sahyog pension top-up?
gold_answer: Between 1 November and 31 December each year.

query: विद्या सेतु छात्रवृत्ति में कितनी राशि मिलती है और किस्तें कब आती हैं?
gold_answer: प्रति वर्ष 6,000 रुपये, 3,000 रुपये की दो किस्तों में, सितंबर और फरवरी में।

query: What is the last date to apply for the Vidya Setu Girls' Scholarship?
gold_answer: 31 August, on the state scholarship portal.

query: Vidya Setu scholarship ke liye attendance kitni honi chahiye?
gold_answer: At least 75 percent attendance in the previous year; below that the student is disqualified for that year.

query: What subsidy does a marginal farmer with 1.5 hectares get on drip irrigation under Kisan Jal Sinchai?
gold_answer: 75 percent, up to a maximum of Rs 80,000 per farmer.

query: किसान जल सिंचाई सब्सिडी में अनुमोदन से पहले खरीदे गए उपकरण का क्या होता है?
gold_answer: अनुमोदन से पहले की गई खरीद की प्रतिपूर्ति नहीं होती; उपकरण अनुमोदन के बाद पैनलबद्ध आपूर्तिकर्ता से खरीदना होता है।

query: How much of the Gram Ujala streetlight grant is paid in advance?
gold_answer: 80 percent in advance; the remaining 20 percent after the block engineer inspects the installation.

query: Gram Ujala grant se generator kharid sakte hain kya?
gold_answer: No. Generators are not an eligible expense; repair of existing lights is.

query: Up to what loan amount is no collateral needed under the Nari Udyam Loan Scheme?
gold_answer: Loans up to Rs 2 lakh need no collateral.

query: नारी उद्यम ऋण योजना में जिला समिति कितने दिनों में निर्णय लेती है?
gold_answer: समिति हर महीने बैठती है और 45 दिनों के भीतर निर्णय लेती है।

query: What does Shramik Suraksha pay on the accidental death of a registered construction worker?
gold_answer: Rs 5 lakh to the nominee named at registration; Rs 2.5 lakh on permanent disability.

query: Shramik Suraksha ka claim kitne time ke andar file karna hota hai?
gold_answer: Within one year of the accident, at the district labour office, with the FIR or accident report and the hospital record.

query: How is the Rs 6,000 Matru Poshan maternity benefit split?
gold_answer: Three instalments of Rs 2,000: on pregnancy registration in the first trimester, after the second antenatal check-up, and after the child's first vaccinations.

query: मातृ पोषण लाभ के लिए गर्भावस्था का पंजीकरण कब तक कराना होता है?
gold_answer: अंतिम माहवारी की तारीख से 150 दिनों के भीतर।

query: What attendance is needed to receive the Yuva Kaushal stipend for a month?
gold_answer: 80 percent attendance in the month.

query: How is the Awas Sahayata housing grant of Rs 1.3 lakh paid out?
gold_answer: In three stages: Rs 40,000 on sanction, Rs 60,000 after the plinth inspection, and Rs 30,000 after the roof is cast.

query: आवास सहायता अनुदान के लिए मकान का न्यूनतम आकार क्या है?
gold_answer: कम से कम 25 वर्ग मीटर।

query: How much is the Swachh Gram toilet incentive and when is it paid?
gold_answer: Rs 12,000, paid within 30 days after the gram panchayat verifies construction with a geotagged photograph.

query: Balika Janm Samriddhi mein kitna paisa jama hota hai aur kab milta hai?
gold_answer: Rs 25,000 is deposited in a fixed deposit in the girl's name; the maturity amount is paid at 18 if she has passed Class 10 and is unmarried.

query: Within what time must a family apply for Balika Janm Samriddhi?
gold_answer: Within one year of the girl's birth, at the district women and child development office.

query: दिव्यांग सहायक योजना में उपकरण पाने के लिए कितने प्रतिशत दिव्यांगता चाहिए?
gold_answer: दिव्यांगता प्रमाण पत्र में 40 प्रतिशत या अधिक।

query: When are the Divyang Sahayak assessment camps held in each block?
gold_answer: Twice a year, in March and September; devices are also issued at the district hospital on any working day.

query: By what date must a farmer register to sell wheat at the procurement centre?
gold_answer: By 15 March for wheat (15 September for paddy).

query: Fasal kharid ke baad payment kitne time mein aata hai?
gold_answer: Within 72 hours of the weighment slip, to the bank account.

query: What share of the premium does the state pay under Pashu Dhan Bima?
gold_answer: 70 percent; the owner pays the rest, about Rs 150 per cow.

query: पशु धन बीमा में पशु की मृत्यु की सूचना कितने समय में देनी होती है?
gold_answer: 24 घंटे के भीतर पशु चिकित्सा कार्यालय को।

query: Who gets a bicycle under the Chhatra Cycle Yojana?
gold_answer: Students entering Class 9 in a government school more than 2 kilometres from their home.

query: How many hours a day must a panchayat library be open to keep its grant?
gold_answer: At least four hours a day, six days a week, free to all residents.

query: Shehri Vendor Card ki fees kitni hai aur kitne saal valid hai?
gold_answer: Rs 100, valid for five years.

query: How much notice must be given before a vendor card holder is removed from an allotted spot?
gold_answer: 30 days' notice.

query: What property tax rebate does rainwater harvesting earn under Jal Sanchay, and for how long?
gold_answer: A 10 percent rebate for five years, starting the financial year after certification.

query: बिजली सहायता योजना में पहली 100 यूनिट की दर क्या है?
gold_answer: 1 रुपये प्रति यूनिट; 100 यूनिट से अधिक खपत होने पर पूरा बिल सामान्य दर पर लगता है।

query: How much does Vidhwa Sahayata pay a widow who has a child under 18?
gold_answer: Rs 1,500 per month (Rs 1,000 without a child under 18).

query: Senior citizen bus pass AC bus mein chalta hai kya?
gold_answer: AC and interstate services are not free; they carry a 50 percent concession.

query: How much foodgrain does an Antyodaya household get per month under Anna Suraksha?
gold_answer: 35 kilograms per household regardless of size.

query: अन्न सुरक्षा में राशन किस तारीख से किस तारीख तक बंटता है?
gold_answer: हर महीने की 1 से 12 तारीख तक, बायोमेट्रिक सत्यापन के बाद।

query: How often can a farmer claim the Krishi Yantra tractor subsidy?
gold_answer: One tractor in ten years, and one implement of each kind in five years.

query: What is the Solar Rooftop Rebate for a 5 kilowatt system?
gold_answer: Rs 18,000 per kilowatt for the first 3 kilowatts and Rs 9,000 per kilowatt for the next 2, so Rs 72,000.

query: ग्रामीण सड़क रखरखाव अनुदान में प्रति किलोमीटर कितनी राशि मिलती है?
gold_answer: प्रति किलोमीटर प्रति वर्ष 25,000 रुपये, पाँच वर्ष से पुरानी सड़कों के लिए।

query: How much revolving fund does a self-help group get after six months of regular meetings?
gold_answer: Rs 15,000; a group that has repaid its first bank loan on time gets a community investment fund of Rs 60,000.

query: Free coaching ke liye Class 12 mein kitne marks chahiye?
gold_answer: At least 60 percent, with family income below Rs 3 lakh.

query: What share of tribal hostel seats is reserved for girls?
gold_answer: 30 percent.

query: मुख्यमंत्री चिकित्सा सहायता में राशि किसे दी जाती है, परिवार को या अस्पताल को?
gold_answer: अस्पताल को, परिवार को नहीं।

query: How often can a family claim Mukhya Mantri Chikitsa Sahayata?
gold_answer: Once in three years per family.

query: Within how many days after a marriage must Kanya Vivah Sahayata be applied for?
gold_answer: Within 90 days after the marriage, at the block office.

query: कन्या विवाह सहायता में कितनी राशि मिलती है और किसके खाते में?
gold_answer: 51,000 रुपये, दुल्हन के बैंक खाते में।

query: Startup seed grant land ya gaadi kharidne mein use kar sakte hain?
gold_answer: No. The grant cannot be used for buying land or vehicles.

query: What is the maximum boat subsidy for registered fisherfolk?
gold_answer: 50 percent, up to Rs 1.5 lakh; nets get 60 percent up to Rs 15,000.

query: How does a handloom weaver claim the yarn subsidy?
gold_answer: It is deducted at the state yarn depot on presenting the handloom identity card; no separate claim is needed.

query: डिजिटल साक्षरता प्रमाण पत्र कार्यक्रम का कोर्स कितने घंटे का है?
gold_answer: 20 घंटे का निःशुल्क कोर्स, जन सेवा केंद्र पर।

query: How much pocket money do residents of a government old age home receive?
gold_answer: Rs 300 per month.

query: State sports scholarship national medal par kitna milta hai?
gold_answer: Rs 5,000 per month for two years from the date of the medal (Rs 2,000 for a state medal).

query: How much ex-gratia is paid for a fully destroyed house in a rural area after a notified disaster?
gold_answer: Rs 1.2 lakh in rural areas (Rs 1.5 lakh in urban areas).

query: वरिष्ठ नागरिक संपत्ति कर छूट किराये पर दी गई संपत्ति पर मिलती है क्या?
gold_answer: नहीं, किराये पर दी गई संपत्ति पर छूट नहीं मिलती।

query: Within how many working days must an officer respond to a complaint on the grievance portal?
gold_answer: 15 working days; on escalation the district head gets 10 more working days.

query: Caste certificate e-District se kitne din mein milta hai?
gold_answer: 15 working days; income and domicile certificates take 7 working days.

query: What is the maximum file size for each scholarship portal document?
gold_answer: 500 KB per PDF.

query: श्रम कल्याण बोर्ड पंजीकरण के लिए कार्य प्रमाण पत्र कितने दिनों का चाहिए?
gold_answer: 90 दिनों का कार्य प्रमाण पत्र, नियोक्ता, ठेकेदार या ट्रेड यूनियन से।
